paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word. The values are averaged over the tasks.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for different models across various categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories labeled as L_4^+ , L_3 , L_2 , L_1 , T , R_1 , R_2 , R_3 , R_4^+ , while the vertical axis represents the "Shapley value", measured on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick intervals of 20 units. Bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars representing different models: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green). The tallest bars appear in category T , where mBERT has an approximate value of 40, XLM-R about 60, and chLSTM reaching the maximum value of 80. In other categories such as L_4^+ , L_3 , L_2 , L_1 , R_1 , R_2 , R_3 , and R_4^+ , the bars are all relatively short, generally below 10. The bars are not sorted in a specific order and are not visually emphasized with special shading or annotations aside from color differentiation for model identification. No Error bars given. A legend is given top right.
